## About
Bales Electric started when Larry Bale decided to start servicing customers on his own. We're still locally owned and operated, working out of Post Oak Dr in Conroe and serving everywhere from Willis all the way to Downtown Houston.
One longtime customer calls the owner, Lorne, a no nonsense, get the job done guy who never pushes unnecessary complications or extras. That's how we like to work: think before we start, do the job promptly and safely, and clean up when we're done.
From a dryer receptacle to a whole home generator, our technicians are ready to help you solve that issue.

## Services
- Electrical Repairs: Having electrical problems you can't track down? Give us a call. Our techs handle ceiling fans, lighting, outlets and GFI outlet repairs.
- Trouble Shooting: We think before we start working to save you money. One reviewer said Mike quickly diagnosed and resolved a tripping breaker panel.
- Panel Upgrades: If your older home can't keep up with today's electrical demands, an electric service panel upgrade can help.
- Lighting Upgrades: Flickering lights or lost power? We can add new lighting or update what you have with LED.
- Surge Protection: Faulty wiring, downed power lines and an overabundance of appliances can overwhelm your electrical system. Whole home surge protectors help keep your home's power out of trouble.
- Home generators: A whole home generator keeps your appliances working during a power outage. One reviewer said Cole installed a generator interlock and left him with a better setup than he expected.
- Tesla and other EV chargers: We install EV chargers at home. One reviewer had us set up a Tesla Wall Connector along with a panel upgrade.
- Install a Ceiling Fan: A ceiling fan is a great choice for cooling a room, from sleek and trendy to standard and traditional.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us for a free estimate.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We service everywhere from Willis all the way to Downtown Houston.

Q: Do you work on homes and businesses?
A: Yes. We offer electrical services for both residential and commercial properties, including upgrades, repairs, replacements and installations.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
